title: Eclipse Ascension
description: Eclipse Ascension is a high-tier combat expansion for Minecraft 1.19.2
body:
🌌 **Eclipse Ascension**
Reach the Zenith of Combat Technology
Eclipse Ascension is a high-tier combat expansion for Minecraft 1.19.2 that introduces five revolutionary material tiers. This isn't just a gear mod; it's a complete combat overhaul featuring specialized set bonuses, tactical weapon abilities, and kinetic-based progression.

⌨️ **Controls & Ability Guide**

Standard Interface
- **[V] (Armor Ability):|** Trigger your equipped armor set's manual ability (Dash, Teleport, etc.).
- **[G] (Weapon Skill):** Activate a weapon's special activated ability (e.g., Katana's Rift Chain).
- **[Right-Click]:** Primary fire for ranged weapons or special secondary actions for melee (e.g., Spear Throw).

💎 **The Material Tiers**

- **Xenium (Energy):** Harness high-density plasma. Specializes in energy shields and rapid-fire plasma weaponry.
- **Stellarium (Crystal):** Precision and control. Features homing projectiles and throw-and-retrieve spear mechanics.
- **Astrion (Stellar):** Pure explosive power. Unleash supernova-level strikes and heavy area-of-effect damage.
- **Neotron (Kinetic):** Mach-speed physics. Master high-velocity railguns and gravity-warping hammers that ignore armor.
- **Voidium (The End):** The ultimate mastery. Command the fabric of space with teleportation, rift-slashes, and spectral Void Wisps.

⚔️ **Key Features**

- **Individual Item Tracking:** Every weapon is unique. Combos and cooldowns are tracked per-item instance, allowing for complex dual-wielding and inventory management.
- **Cinematic Combat:** Experience abilities like the Rift Chain, which teleports you through a series of blink-attacks, complete with custom camera effects and particles.
- **Dynamic HUD:** A custom overlay tracks your active ability cooldowns in real-time.
- **Balanced Piercing:** Projectiles like the Neotron Railspike use advanced hit-detection loops to ensure they strike exactly 5 targets in a line, even at "mach" velocities.

**Armor Set Bonuses**

- **Xenium:** Phase Shield (Toggle [V] for visibility). Grants a recharging 10-hit energy shield.
- **Stellarium:** Gravity Well. While crouching, you become immune to knockback and gravity is significantly increased.
- **Astrion:** Blast Dampening. Massive resistance to explosions; you are immune to your own weapons' blasts.
- **Neotron:** Kinetic Dash [V]. A high-speed forward dash that penetrates through mobs.
- **Voidium:** Void Step [V]. Teleport instantly to your looking position (up to 32 blocks).

**Weapon Masteries & Combos
Most melee weapons trigger a "Finisher" on every 5th consecutive hit.**

- **Xenium Blade:** Triggers an Energy Charge bonus for extra magic damage.
- **Stellarium Spear:** Use Right-Click to throw. The spear will stay centered on your screen for a cinematic throw.
- **Astrion War Axe:** Triggers a Nova Strike—a massive explosion at the point of impact.
- **Neotron Gravity Hammer:** Triggers a Gravity Slam, creating a shockwave that launches all nearby enemies into the sky.
- **Voidium Rift Katana:**  
**Rift Chain [G]:** Needs a 5-hit combo. Teleport and strike 5 enemies in a blink.  
**Void Counterstep:** You automatically blink behind attackers and counter-slash when you get hit.  
 **Void Wisps:** Every 3–6 hits summons a swarm of 3 spectral orbs that relentlessly hunt your enemies.
